name: status-row
notes: The status row only exists when should_render_status_row() is true, which needs a status_message while idle — /status is the cheapest way to arm it. It also pushes a system annotation, so this one scenario pins both the status row and the system-annotation transcript style. Catches the status row losing a row to render_app's prompt_height clamp when the message wraps (the div_ceil(display_width(text)) measurement path). NOTE: deliberately does NOT assert any_modal_open — on a host with audio, voice_mode_notice is visible from frame 0, so any_modal_open is true for the whole run and the assertion would be host-dependent rather than surface-dependent.
